name: Build and Defend Your Raft
desc:
🌊 Build and Defend Your Raft! 🛠️

Start with a tiny wooden boat and build your way up to the ULTIMATE RAFT!

🪵 Collect resources and expand your raft
🔨 Upgrade your Crafting Table to unlock better gear
🛡️ Build powerful defenses and protect your loot
⚔️ Raid other players' rafts
💰 Break into their rafts and STEAL their loot!

🔥 NEW UPDATES EVERY SATURDAY
⭐ Favorite the game for more updates!
